points.quote: `defineBlockSchema({ flavour, metadata, toModel })` comes from `@blocksuite/store`. The flavour is a namespaced string such as `'affine:divider'`. `metadata` holds `version`, `role` (for example `'content'`) and the allowed `children`.
The model is a class that extends `BlockModel<Props>`. Here that is `DividerBlockModel`.

The view is a Lit element that extends `BlockComponent<Model>` from `@blocksuite/std`. ... `this.renderChildren(this.model)` renders child blocks. ... `setup(context)` calls `context.register([BlockViewExtension('affine:divider', literal\`affine-divider\`), …])`.

Store side, in `store.ts`: `class DividerStoreExtension extends StoreExtensionProvider`. ... View side, in `view.ts`: `class DividerViewExtension extends ViewExtensionProvider`. ... The providers are loaded through `StoreExtensionManager` and `ViewExtensionManager` (`blocksuite/affine/ext-loader/src/`).
`effect()` calls `effects()`, which defines the custom element.
